projects.title: Solar Proa II - Power Management System
projects.bodyText:
- Designed and implemented a high powered electrical system and wireless communication network for sensor communication and data collection for a wind and solar powered 48V, 4kW electrical vessel using custom firmware, software, hardware and PCB. 
 - Consist of a network of **ESP32** and **Raspberry Pi** devices that communicate with each other using **ESP-NOW** protocol to run a custom **E.Kalman Filter** algorithm. 
 - Developed a **web-based dashboard** using **React** and **Node.js** to visualize the power consumption data and provide real-time feedback to the user, including a developer / admin portal with authentication for controlling the system.

projects.title: Solar Proa II - Digital Twin & Simulation
projects.bodyText:
- A digital twin and simulation of the Solar Proa II vessel using **GNU Make**, **Python**, and **PySpice**. 
 - The software uses a parametised step model approach to achieve a single, unified model for the vessel. 
 - The simulation is used to test and validate the power management system, electrical wiring, and the vessel's performance under different conditions such as varying weather and time of day.

projects.title: PDF and Image Converter (Personal favourite and used a lot)
projects.bodyText:
- A Windows application with UI that runs locally to modify PDFs and image page ordering. Mainly used for **re-ordering** pdf pages and **combining** images between them. Can convert images to PDF and vice versa with option for different formats and quality.
 - Allows for **compact view** & disabling preview to load pdf with hundreds of pages in **seconds**. 
 - Made using **Python**, **PySide** and **PyInstaller**.
 - Not meant for photo editing but very convinient to use when handling many pdf and images at once without using online website or Adobe.

projects.title: Trie Auto Complete
projects.bodyText:
- A lightweight command-line interface application for **auto-completing** words using a Trie data structure.
 - Easy to use and integrate into any script running on CLI for **custom words, symbol and characters**.
 - Can be adapted into an interface if required but probably have existing library for this purpose in pip or npm.

projects.title: Text to (QR) Code Generator
projects.bodyText:
- A **JavaFX** App that generates **Scannable Code** (QR, barcode, etc) from text and scans.
 - Uses **ZXing** library to generate the code and OpenCV to correct and align the code.
 - Supports different encryption levels, color and customised logo in the QR Code.
 - Additional validation step by **rescanning** generated code, especially important for customised embeded logo 
 - As this is the first Java app I made, it is badly designed, slow and cannot be exported as an appication but works fine otherwise.

projects.title: Bank Sync
projects.bodyText:
- A simple Transation Statement parser and organiser web app made with just **Python**, **React** and **Supabase**. Backend works completely off Javascript, Python Scripts and Supabase query.
 - Uses real transaction data from common banks in Singapore in PDF or Excel, which is parsed and stored in a database.
 - Works for different banks with different formatting **without** the need to run **OCR** model or **LLM** (lightweight and completely offline if hosted locally) 
 - Users can view, update and export their transactions and filter by date, category, and amount, giving user full control over their financial data. 
 - Comes with data analysis for insights across multiple accounts and banks.

projects.title: AWS x Mandai Hackathon [Vibe-Coded]
projects.bodyText:
- A recreation of a hackathon project vibe-coded entirely using **Kiro**, a AI powered IDE. 
 - Completely prompted from scratch by specifying everything, from project description, direction, down to testing method, file structuring  and development rules & restriction (see in GitHub readme). 
 - Besic movement physics, database catalogue and interesting features for a short hackathon project built in half a day.
